findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so coordinate contrasts are not physical interaction energies.

Continuous contrast functions over the observed window [0,0.5] show sign changes and rate reversals for landmark local coordinate features: e.g. landmark_00_local_dy has first_rate_z -72.4 and last_rate_z +5.5 with 6 sign changes, and landmark_00_local_dx has first_rate_z -17.5 and last_rate_z +8.1 with 6 sign changes. These are time-conditioned, not constant, rules, and no extrapolation is allowed.

Landmark soft-mass (landmark_00_soft_mass) shows a strong early positive rate (first_rate_z 9.27) reversing to a strong negative late rate (last_rate_z -10.0) with 4 sign changes and one strong sign conflict, indicating a supported time-conditioned contrast rather than a constant rule.

Branch-adjusted raw-covariance contrasts for global centroid coordinates are not distinguishable from zero (global_centroid_x p=0.60, y p=0.55, z p=0.95; all q>0.69), so centroid position provides no multiplicity-adjusted support for a coordinate hypothesis.

Shape covariance contrasts are the only branch-adjusted features approaching significance: shape_yy has p=0.048 with 78.6% same-sign batches and negative whole-window mean, and shape_xx has p=0.096 with 78.6% same-sign batches; both remain non-significant after multiplicity adjustment (q=0.153 and q=0.232).

hypotheses.direction: time-conditioned contrast on landmark local coordinate features
hypotheses.falsifier: A constant-rule fit achieving equal or lower relative node RMSE than the observed-node linear time-conditioned fit, or absence of the early/late rate sign reversal in held-out observed nodes.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dy and landmark_00_local_dx contrast values at observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned contrast rule on landmark local coordinate features (e.g. landmark_00_local_dy and landmark_00_local_dx) would express the observed early-negative/late-positive rate reversal better than a constant rule, since both features show large first-to-last rate sign flips with multiple sign changes.

hypotheses.falsifier: Multiplicity-adjusted q remaining above the declared threshold, or same-sign batch fraction dropping toward 0.5 in additional independent batches.
hypotheses.observable: branch_mutation raw_covariance for shape_yy and shape_xx
hypotheses.statement: A shape-covariance-oriented coordinate contrast (shape_yy, shape_xx) is the most plausible branch-level coordinate hypothesis, since these are the only branch-adjusted features with same-sign batch fractions near 0.79 and the smallest p-values.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels or current-study outcome data are supplied, so last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit; the immediate-selection versus descendant-survival comparison is unavailable.

Continuous trend rows report observed-node linear fits with polynomial_accepted=false and no extrapolation; no validated parametric fit is available to justify a specific time-conditioned functional form.
Branch-adjusted and continuous-trend evidence are diagnostic coordinate contrasts, not physical interaction energies or evidence of neural-module causation.
No joint-diagnostics, turnover-accounting, survival, endpoint or increment rows were read in this analysis, so coupling, cohort-composition and terminal-credit questions remain unaddressed.

task.formula: R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau), q=detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance; rho_delta=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1). Actual pointcloud_delta_A defaults to 1 A. Native endpoint VJP, no affinity-head derivative, no extra model forward. teacher_neighbors is a count; temporal_recipe changes only a registered scalar/attention, not velocity. No temperature edits. Inert legacy metadata is not a reward term.

formula_registry.diagnostic_limit: Moment effects, pair kernels and turnover are diagnostic evidence. Executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; legacy robust_delta is inert.
formula_registry.dose: Endpoint-VJP force normalized and RMS-scaled against native predictive update; eta/ramp only in U lane.
formula_registry.prior: Detached nearest-k teachers; log_pi=-q_anchor/prior_temperature; scores beta=0; k is a count.
formula_registry.regional: Detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention; positive surrounding weight.
formula_registry.temporal_region: Same static teachers; validated absolute contrast changes regional attention at observed score nodes.
formula_registry.temporal_teacher: (1-blend)*R_static + blend*R_observed_teacher(time); same shared FLOWR endpoint, no velocity target.

incumbent.topology_policy: Free native graph transitions; no pair-distance acceptance or graph equality veto

task.objective: Final predicted target affinity primary; validity and strain secondary; coordinate control only
